# per-section stats

    n=0
    for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        if 0<=rr<4 and 0<=cc<4 and sec[rr][cc]:n+=1
    return n

    for r in range(4):
        for c in range(4):
            stats[(colors[s],r,c)]=dict(
                rowc=sum(sec[r]), colc=sum(sec[i][c] for i in range(4)),
                tot=sum(map(sum,sec)), nb=nbrs(sec,r,c),
                vrun=0,hrun=0)
            i=r

            i=r
            while i>=0 and sec[i][c]: stats[(colors[s],r,c)]['vrun']+=1; i-=1
            stats[(colors[s],r,c)]['vrun']-=1
            j=c
            while j<4 and sec[r][j]: stats[(colors[s],r,c)]['hrun']+=1; j+=1
            j=c
            while j>=0 and sec[r][j]: stats[(colors[s],r,c)]['hrun']+=1; j-=1

keys=['rowc','colc','tot','nb','vrun','hrun']
